SELECT customer_id, order_id, placed_at
FROM main.shop.orders
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY placed_at DESC) = 1

SELECT category, sku, revenue
FROM product_revenue
QUALIFY rank() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC) <= 3

SELECT order_date, amount,
  sum(amount) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_amount
FROM daily_sales

SELECT store_id, sale_date, revenue,
  avg(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY sale_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS revenue_7d
FROM store_sales

SELECT device_id, reading_at, temperature,
  max(temperature) OVER (
    PARTITION BY device_id
    ORDER BY reading_at
    RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 1 HOUR PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS max_last_hour
FROM sensor_readings

SELECT account_id, txn_date, balance,
  balance - lag(balance, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_date) AS change,
  lead(txn_date) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_date) AS next_txn_date
FROM balances

SELECT team, player, points,
  rank() OVER w AS points_rank,
  percent_rank() OVER w AS points_pct
FROM scores
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY points DESC)

SELECT sku, snapshot_date,
  last_value(price, true) OVER (PARTITION BY sku ORDER BY snapshot_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS filled_price
FROM price_snapshots

SELECT customer_id, lifetime_value,
  ntile(10) OVER (ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC) AS decile,
  dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC) AS value_rank
FROM customer_value

SELECT o.order_id, item
FROM orders AS o
LATERAL VIEW explode(o.items) t AS item

SELECT o.order_id, tag
FROM orders AS o
LATERAL VIEW OUTER explode(o.tags) t AS tag

SELECT order_id, pos AS line_number, item.sku, item.qty
FROM orders
LATERAL VIEW posexplode(items) lines AS pos, item

SELECT order_id, sku, qty
FROM orders
LATERAL VIEW inline(items) li AS sku, qty

SELECT user_id, setting_key, setting_value
FROM user_settings
LATERAL VIEW explode(settings) s AS setting_key, setting_value

SELECT order_id, explode(items) AS item
FROM orders

SELECT id, posexplode(split(path, '/')) AS (depth, segment)
FROM categories
SELECT user_id, explode_outer(emails) AS email FROM users

SELECT o.order_id, i.col AS item
FROM orders AS o, LATERAL explode(o.items) AS i

SELECT e.event_id, v.key, v.value::string AS value
FROM events AS e, LATERAL variant_explode(e.payload) AS v

SELECT customer.name, customer.address.city, customer.address.postcode
FROM orders

SELECT request_id, headers['user-agent'] AS user_agent, element_at(headers, 'referer') AS referer
FROM web_requests

SELECT order_id, items[0] AS first_item, element_at(items, -1) AS last_item, size(items) AS item_count
FROM orders
SELECT try_element_at(scores, 10) AS tenth_score, try_element_at(attrs, 'colour') AS colour FROM products

SELECT named_struct('id', customer_id, 'name', full_name, 'tier', loyalty_tier) AS customer
FROM customers
SELECT struct(order_id, amount AS total, currency) AS order_summary FROM orders
SELECT map('EUR', 1.08, 'GBP', 1.27, 'USD', 1.0) AS rates_to_usd
SELECT array(1, 2, 3) AS small, array('a', 'b') AS letters, array() AS empty
SELECT map_from_arrays(collect_list(code), collect_list(label)) AS labels FROM country_codes

SELECT user_id,
  array_contains(roles, 'admin') AS is_admin,
  array_distinct(array_union(roles, extra_roles)) AS all_roles,
  array_join(roles, ', ') AS role_list
FROM user_roles
SELECT order_id, shipping.* FROM orders
SELECT order_id, transform(items, i -> i.qty * i.unit_price) AS line_totals FROM orders
SELECT order_id, filter(items, i -> i.qty > 0) AS shipped_items FROM orders
SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE exists(items, i -> i.sku LIKE 'GIFT-%')
SELECT order_id, forall(items, i -> i.qty > 0) AS all_positive FROM orders
SELECT order_id, aggregate(items, 0D, (acc, i) -> acc + i.qty * i.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders
SELECT reduce(array(2, 4, 6), 0, (acc, x) -> acc + x, acc -> acc / 3) AS mean_value

SELECT array_sort(items, (l, r) -> CASE WHEN l.qty < r.qty THEN 1 WHEN l.qty > r.qty THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_qty_desc
FROM orders
SELECT transform(array('a', 'b', 'c'), (x, i) -> concat(cast(i AS STRING), ':', x)) AS numbered

SELECT map_filter(stock, (k, v) -> v > 0) AS in_stock,
  transform_values(prices, (k, v) -> round(v * 1.2, 2)) AS gross_prices
FROM inventory_snapshot
SELECT zip_with(quantities, prices, (q, p) -> q * p) AS line_totals FROM baskets
SELECT order_id::bigint, amount::decimal(18, 2), placed_at::date AS placed_on FROM raw_orders
SELECT try_cast(quantity_text AS INT) AS quantity, try_cast(price_text AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS price FROM staged_lines
SELECT CAST(event_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_at, CAST(flag AS BOOLEAN) AS is_active FROM raw_events

SELECT try_to_number(amount_text, '9999.99') AS amount,
  to_date(order_day, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS order_date,
  try_to_timestamp(created_text, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS created_at
FROM staged_orders

SELECT payload:customer.id::string AS customer_id,
  payload:items[0].sku::string AS first_sku,
  payload:['shipping address'].city::string AS city
FROM raw_events
SELECT parse_json(body) AS doc, try_parse_json(body) IS NULL AS is_invalid FROM webhook_inbox

SELECT from_json(body, 'STRUCT<id: STRING, amount: DOUBLE, tags: ARRAY<STRING>>') AS parsed
FROM webhook_inbox
SELECT get_json_object(body, '$.order.id') AS order_id, to_json(named_struct('ok', true)) AS ack FROM webhook_inbox

SELECT region, channel, count(*) AS orders, sum(amount) AS revenue
FROM orders
GROUP BY ALL

SELECT region, country, sum(amount) AS revenue
FROM orders
GROUP BY ROLLUP (region, country)
ORDER BY region, country

SELECT channel, device, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM sessions
GROUP BY CUBE (channel, device)

SELECT region, product_line, sum(units) AS units, grouping_id() AS level
FROM sales

SELECT year, quarter, sum(revenue) AS revenue FROM finance_quarters GROUP BY year, quarter WITH ROLLUP

SELECT customer_id,
  count(*) AS orders,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RETURNED') AS returns
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING count(*) >= 5

SELECT category,
  count_if(is_discounted) AS discounted,
  approx_count_distinct(customer_id) AS customers,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount) AS median_amount,
  max_by(sku, amount) AS top_sku,
  collect_set(brand) AS brands
FROM order_lines
GROUP BY category

SELECT order_id, listagg(sku, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY line_no) AS skus
FROM order_lines
GROUP BY order_id

SELECT *
FROM (SELECT region, quarter, revenue FROM quarterly_revenue)
PIVOT (sum(revenue) AS total FOR quarter IN ('Q1' AS q1, 'Q2' AS q2, 'Q3' AS q3, 'Q4' AS q4))

SELECT *
FROM monthly_kpis
UNPIVOT (kpi_value FOR kpi_name IN (orders, revenue, refunds))

SELECT *
FROM sensor_wide
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (reading FOR sensor IN (s1 AS sensor_1, s2 AS sensor_2))

MERGE INTO main.shop.customers AS t
USING staging_customers AS s
ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET *
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *

MERGE INTO inventory AS t
USING inventory_changes AS s
ON t.sku = s.sku AND t.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
WHEN MATCHED AND s.op = 'D' THEN DELETE
WHEN MATCHED AND s.updated_at > t.updated_at THEN UPDATE SET t.on_hand = s.on_hand, t.updated_at = s.updated_at
WHEN NOT MATCHED AND s.op <> 'D' THEN INSERT (sku, warehouse_id, on_hand, updated_at) VALUES (s.sku, s.warehouse_id, s.on_hand, s.updated_at)

MERGE INTO active_subscriptions AS t
USING (SELECT * FROM subscription_feed WHERE feed_date = current_date()) AS s
ON t.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET *
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN DELETE

MERGE INTO products AS t
USING product_feed AS s
ON t.sku = s.sku
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.price = s.price
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (sku, price, is_active) VALUES (s.sku, s.price, true)
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE AND t.is_active THEN UPDATE SET t.is_active = false

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT * FROM order_events QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY event_at DESC) = 1
)
MERGE INTO orders AS t
USING latest AS s
ON t.order_id = s.order_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.status = s.status
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (order_id, status) VALUES (s.order_id, s.status)

MERGE WITH SCHEMA EVOLUTION INTO events AS t
USING new_events AS s
ON t.event_id = s.event_id
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS main.shop.order_lines (
  order_id STRING NOT NULL,
  line_no INT,
  sku STRING,
  amount DECIMAL(18, 2),
  order_date DATE
)
USING DELTA
PARTITIONED BY (order_date)
COMMENT 'One row per order line'

CREATE TABLE main.shop.page_views (
  view_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
  session_id STRING,
  url STRING,
  viewed_at TIMESTAMP
)
USING DELTA
CLUSTER BY (session_id, viewed_at)

CREATE TABLE main.shop.clickstream (
  event_id STRING,
  user_id STRING,
  event_type STRING,
  event_at TIMESTAMP
)
CLUSTER BY AUTO
